mechanism_narrative: ERBB4 (RTK) and IL6ST/gp130 (cytokine receptor) are forced into proximity by the flexible GS4 linker (~20 Å). ERBB4's intrinsic tyrosine kinase transphosphorylates IL6ST's intracellular domain, activating STAT3 directly while also engaging GRB2-SHC-RAS-MAPK and PI3K-AKT via shared adaptor docking. PLCγ is sterically excluded by the asymmetric RTK-cytokine ICD geometry. The biased output is a hybrid MAPK/PI3K/STAT3 signal that upregulates muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11) and suppresses aged inflammatory IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32), mirroring the rejuvenating signature of the ERBB2+FGFR wins.
